_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 90: 4-8 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says it just keeps growing and people say they are okay when they are not, asks what they do about it, says Jesus is coming and it is all part of the system and all part of the plan, and works through an AI calculation that spending ten million dollars a day since 1 AD to today's year of 2026 comes to about 7.4 trillion.
mentions.quote: It's all part of the system. It's all part of the plan
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: part of the plan names no agent, action or date.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The arithmetic is checkable and roughly right, but it is a figure of speech about the size of the debt, not a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for a visual contact for the Senate seats available in the 2026 election, correcting himself from 2028, along with the House seats available, says they will pray over all these seats and over the governors' races, and thanks God that it will give them a visual contact.
mentions.quote: the Senate seats and the House seats that are available
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: praying over a published list of contested seats.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what he told them was coming on April 1st and notes people dismissed it as April Fool's Day, says the Lord said an acceleration of signs in the heavens, that from this time to September the 11th of this year it will be a time of acceleration, and that he said great things will start to be fearful sights seen from the heavens that will bring people to their knees.
mentions.quote: the Lord said an acceleration of signs in the heavens
mentions.falsify_match: An unusual run of celestial events across those five months.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary five months. Signs in the heavens has no threshold, and meteors, auroras and eclipses occur continuously, so the window cannot come up empty.

mentions.claim_text: He says he spoke of news that will shake the heavens and that this will start on April 1st, that this is the time frame, Passover, that he said to watch this, asks what will happen again today, and says he said it will happen up in the northeast from Seattle all the way to New York, that he saw all up northeast, and that he even has the videos to prove it.
mentions.quote: this will start on April 1st. This is the time frame, Passover
mentions.falsify_match: Meteor sightings across the named corridor after 1 April.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported in that corridor. He offers the videos himself, which is the right way to make a priority claim. Note the geography: Seattle to New York is most of the continent, not a region.

mentions.claim_text: He says it would be up north and lists June 1st, May 27th and May 30th in Boston, that they are all entering in just like the Lord said and he is shaking the Northeast and it is happening, that he said to wait for the one to happen over Seattle because it is going to be massive, that he saw something massive coming, and that he saw two hands split and go across the land which was symbolic.
mentions.quote: Wait for the wand to happen over Seattle. It's going to be massive
mentions.falsify_match: A major meteor event over Seattle.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The dated sightings he counts are ordinary fireball reports, which the American Meteor Society logs by the thousand each year, so the base rate is the whole question. The Seattle event is the part still outstanding and is the only piece with a stated magnitude.

mentions.claim_text: He asks when the Lord spoke about the beef, is told June 27th of 2025, and plays the recording in which he said there is coming a controlling of beef and a fear to eat beef, that a manipulation of the beef is coming, that there is something with the cows and something wrong with the cows kind of like mad cow disease, and another flare-up of something wrong with the beef.
mentions.quote: There there's coming a controlling of beef. A fear to eat beef
mentions.falsify_match: A cattle disease outbreak restricting beef supply after June 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: No outbreak. The origin recording is played on air with a date given, which is the strongest form a priority claim can take here and can be verified directly against the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says prices and organic beef will be skyrocketing, that he saw it going up and the Lord said this will become very valuable for people who are growing organic beef, that he said they are going to make this bigger than it is in the days ahead, that this was a year ago on June the 27th, and that here they are almost a year later seeing it in the news.
mentions.falsify_match: Organic beef prices rising sharply after June 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: Prices flat or falling. Beef prices are published series, so this is directly measurable, which makes it one of the few economic claims here that can be scored to a number rather than argued about.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls hearing 88 reasons why Jesus is coming in 88 and that Jesus did not come in 88 and people got really weird in 1988, asks whether they remember how flaky people got in 2020 and in the year 2000 when people said Jesus is coming and that they would never see the new millennium, and notes drily that they are 27 years into it.
mentions.quote: There's 88 reasons why Jesus is coming in 88
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a historical account of failed date-setting.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth recording as the clearest thing he says about other people's failed predictions, given how much dated material he carries himself. He names the mechanism and does not apply it to his own dates.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip about people wanting them there and calls it prophetic confirmation, asks what the Lord said, answers that they are going to liberate Cuba and bring business, that he said there is going to be big money coming to Cuba and to watch, that this was back in January, and asks his son when it was, who says he has seen it so many times about Cuba.
mentions.quote: there's going to be big money coming to Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Investment flowing into Cuba after a change of government.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. Neither he nor his son can date the original word here, saying only that it has been seen so many times, which is exactly the looseness that makes a priority claim unverifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why they are burning things and answers that they have paid demonstrators, says this is why he is telling them to pray about the 14th next week, that he saw paid demonstrators and rioting and craziness trying to break out in this nation and civil unrest through groups like Antifa, and tells them to remember he said to watch the black stone, black onyx.
mentions.quote: I saw paid demonstrator. I saw rioting
mentions.falsify_match: Rioting and civil unrest on 14 June.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet day. A single named date makes this scoreable, and it is now past due. Protests on the 14th were already publicly scheduled when he said this, so the base rate for unrest that day was not low.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will start to manifest in June and is starting to manifest this month right now, that even by the 14th he sees it, naming the wealth transfer twice, and that this month they will start to see the trickle and are going to see it.
mentions.quote: It will it will start to manifest in June
mentions.falsify_match: Listeners receiving unexpected money during June.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Now past due. A trickle is the smallest possible claim: it needs no threshold and any single testimony satisfies it, which is what the wording is doing.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not an organised event but a lone wolf attacker concerning San Antonio, an individual, that he sees one dominant and two others but does not see anything else right now, that he sees a black hoodie, and that this person will be easy to spot because a black hoodie in June in San Antonio is out of place and does not match.
mentions.quote: This is a lone wolf attacker concerning uh San Antonio
mentions.falsify_match: A lone attacker in San Antonio in June wearing a black hoodie.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack, which is what happened. Now past due. This is among the most specific claims in the corpus: a named city, a month, a count of one dominant plus two, and a described garment, with his own reasoning for why it would be noticed.

mentions.claim_text: He names Eric and Don Jr in prayer and says the Lord said this is the time he warned them about, repeats that this is the time he warned them about, says he warned them about Jack back in January, and that this is when Usha's baby is about ready and this is the time.
mentions.quote: This is when Usha Osha's baby is about ready
mentions.falsify_match: The president removed while the vice president's wife is near term.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not happen, which is what happened: the baby was born and the president was not removed. Recorded because this is the passage that sets the timing the later 'we did our job' fulfilment claim depends on.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of praying against an attempt to overthrow him and against what he saw, correcting himself from September to a January 6th moment for the nation trying to come about, and says everybody has been watching his health and his going to the doctors and them giving reports showing his mind is right, and that he has been praying about him refusing the doctor's report.
mentions.quote: a new September I mean I'm I'm sorry not September uh January 6th
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt to remove the president framed as a repeat of January 6th.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attempt. He corrects the month mid-sentence from September to January 6th, which is worth noting: January 6th here is a name for a kind of event rather than a date, so the claim carries no timing at all.
